every Question's answer is an Answer object whose only content is `text`, which is skipped, leaving the Answer with no fields; a nested record with no fields is not emitted. On THIS page the prose states 20% anyway, so nothing is lost here -- but on a JavaScript-rendered FAQ the answer body would be the only copy.
